deploy-bot: Starting canary deploy to staging for tag rc-42 (commit a1b2c3d). Initiating CI gate checks and running pre-deploy smoke.
ci-bot: CI Gate report: FAILURE. Summary: unit-tests-coverage decreased by 3.4% (threshold 1.0%). Failing job: unit-tests-coverage (link: <https://ci.internal/jobs/1247|job #1247>)
maya: ack — I see the alert. Pulling the coverage report now.
sam: which files dropped coverage? can someone paste the coverage diff?
lisa: looks like tokenizer-utils.js lost coverage — new code path in streaming parser not covered by tests. small diffs in PR #789.
raj: given the coverage regression, recommend halting canary and rolling back to rc-41. We shouldn't proceed with degraded coverage.
maya: +1 to rollback. rc-41 had green coverage and passed load smoke earlier today.
sam: mitigation options: 1) revert the change in PR #789 (fast), 2) add minimal unit tests to cover the new branch (slightly slower). What's preferred?
lisa: I can open a tiny test PR that adds the missing cases, ETA ~45m. But that won't help the live canary now.
deploy-bot: Canary paused by CI gate: "coverage-below-threshold". Manual action required. To abort canary: `/deploy abort staging rc-42 --reason "ci-gate-failure"`
maya: executing abort now.
maya: ```
/deploy abort staging rc-42 --reason "ci-gate-failure:coverage-drop"
``` 
raj: also please disable auto-retry for this pipeline until we triage, otherwise it will loop.
sam: noted. I'll flip the retry flag on the pipeline: `ci.pipeline.retry=false`
ci-bot: A manual rollback has been requested. Starting rollback to tag rc-41 (commit z9y8x7w).
deploy-bot: Rollback started: staging -> rc-41. Expected duration ~2m.
ci-bot: Rollback completed. Post-rollback smoke checks: PASS. Coverage baseline restored to previous level.
maya: thanks everyone. Action items: lisa will open the test PR (ETA 45m), sam will prepare a revert PR if needed, and I'll add a note to the release tracker and block rc-42 from further rollouts until coverage fixed.
lisa: opening PR now, will tag @sam for quick review. :thumbsup:
raj: I'll annotate the release notes: "Canary halted — coverage regression detected; rolled back to rc-41. Root cause: missing tests for tokenizer-utils streaming branch."
maya: good. once tests merge and CI gate green, we can re-run a canary. For now marking rc-42 as blocked.
sam: agree. thanks for quick responses. :lock:
deploy-bot: Thread closed by manual rollback action. If someone needs a rerun, use `/deploy start staging rc-42` after CI green.
